## Summary

Pocock's announcement: the talk introduces **/retro** and **/pr**, and how to get more PRs through an org faster by (1) stopping the slop and (2) making PRs easier to review with /pr. Shoopy's share frames the hook: "Opus 5 got addicted to writing tests that just repeat the code back to itself" — and walks through how to stop AI PRs from turning your repo into a slop cannon (their marked timestamp: 5:30 → "the tests AI writes that…", text truncated at capture). The quoted tweet in the share chain (@0xShoopy, 2026-08-25) points to a login-gated X article (x.com/i/article/2091510704201228288) — content unfetchable at capture, same wall as the [[2026-09-17-kovainvest-x-article-share]] case.

## Why it matters

- **This is the video source for techniques already in the vault.** [[2026-09-06-pocock-reviewable-ai-prs]] captured the techniques list (/show-me diffs, pseudocode, Mermaid, TDD evidence); this talk is where /pr and /retro get their full treatment. The vault's Pocock cluster now covers: reviewable PRs (Sep 6) → standards accretion (Sep 26 morning) → this talk (Sep 25, captured here) → Jev fuzzy-linter endorsement (Sep 26 evening). One author, one thesis: **review throughput is the bottleneck of AI-assisted orgs, and it's solved with cheap artifacts, not more reviewer discipline.**
- **"Tests that repeat the code back" names the exact failure the OpenClaw audit quantified.** [[2026-09-26-drummatick-openclaw-test-audit]] (same capture batch): 400k LOC of tests deleted with no coverage change. Shoopy's framing and Steinberger's audit are the same phenomenon from two ends — AI writes tests as an alibi, not a check.
- **/retro is the piece our own workflow most lacks.** /pr has analogues (draft-and-show, review gates); /retro — presumably a structured post-task retrospective that feeds findings back into standing rules — is the missing half of the loop Pocock describes in [[2026-09-26-pocock-coding-standards-accretion]]: failures → standards → cheap checks. A /retro step at task close is a concrete, zero-cost adoption candidate for this company's own end-of-task checklist.
- **Skepticism gates:** talk not yet watched — /retro's actual mechanics are inferred from the title, not verified (do not adopt from this note alone). No metrics in either tweet ("more PRs through your org faster" is a talk pitch, not a result). The X-article in the share chain is inaccessible without login; its content is assumed, not read.
